project_type: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite 7 SPA with Supabase backend
build_system: npm (Node v22). If node/npm not on PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"
test_framework: Vitest (vitest run). Pure-function unit tests live in __tests__ dirs next to source, e.g. src/features/courses/__tests__/helpers.test.ts
test_command: npm run test  (vitest run). Also: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint (eslint .), npm run format:check (prettier --check .)
verification_instructions: Run npm run build (must be green), npm run lint (must stay at exactly 6 pre-existing warnings, 0 errors, no NEW warnings), npm run test (all pass), npm run format:check. No live Supabase in sandbox, so RLS/trigger/SQL behavior can only be reviewed structurally, not executed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/types/database.ts is GENERATED by the user via `supabase gen types` and must NOT be hand-edited. Type compat is handled via src/types/supabase-compat.ts (NormalizeDatabase shim) and boundary casts. No build-produced files are checked in besides dist/ (gitignored output).
setup_instructions: Dependencies already installed/locked. export PATH for node v22 if needed. No .env.local needed to build/typecheck/test (supabase.ts throws only at runtime when env missing; tests/build do not instantiate it against a live server).
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET but NO live Supabase instance. RLS policies, DB triggers (set_course_published_at), and any SQL cannot be executed/verified in the sandbox; validate by logic/structural review only and state this honestly. Do NOT hand-edit src/types/database.ts. Only add a supabase/migrations/ file (next would be 0020_) if a genuine backend gap is found; this task is expected to need NONE.
contribution_requirements: Keep lint clean (0 errors; do not add new warnings beyond the 6 pre-existing in untouched files Toast.tsx, AuthProvider.tsx, LessonView.tsx, QuestionComponents.tsx, NotebookPage.tsx x2). Keep Portuguese (pt-BR) as the UI language. Match existing code style; run prettier.
key_patterns: Error handling today uses two patterns: (i) catch blocks doing `err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Não foi possível X.'` surfaced via useToast().error(...) or a local ErrorText state; (ii) react-query page states rendering `<ErrorText>Não foi possível carregar X.</ErrorText>` that throw away query.error. Supabase errors are PostgrestError-shaped (message/details/hint/code) OR AuthError. Data layer: src/features/courses/api.ts has TanStack Query hooks (useCourseDetail returns full course tree: course + modules + lessons + questions; saveCourseTree persists a CourseDraft with draft-vs-published gated branches; useSaveCourse wraps it + notify_course_update). Editability helpers already exist in src/features/courses/helpers.ts: isExistingContentLocked / canEditExistingContent / nextModulePosition, with unit tests. The editor CreateCoursePage.tsx already renders lock-aware (contentLocked, moduleLocked, isPersisted) but courseId/courseStatus are hardcoded undefined/'draft' because no edit entry point hydrates them. Migration 0019 enforces draft(full edit)/published(add-new-modules-only) server-side via courses.published_at + RLS. Routes are defined in src/App.tsx; /create mounts CreateCoursePage inside ProtectedRoute>AppShell.

src/features/courses/CatalogPage.tsx (Criados por mim tab; add Editar entry point)

src/features/rooms/RoomDetailPage.tsx (15 generic messages), src/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.tsx (5), and ~15 files total listed in context

directory_structure: src/features/<feature>/ (auth, courses, courses/create, dashboard, lesson, rooms, rankings, friends, notifications, notebook, profile, settings, crud, gamification, landing) each with components + api.ts + helpers.ts + __tests__. src/components/ui (Button, Input, Select, Modal, Toast, Spinner, ErrorText, etc.) + src/components/layout (AppShell). src/lib (supabase client, queryClient). src/domain (server-mirrored rules). src/types (database.ts GENERATED, supabase-compat.ts, domain.ts). src/routes (ProtectedRoute, AdminRoute, NotFoundPage). supabase/migrations 0001-0019 + config.toml + README.md. Docs: README.md at root, supabase/README.md.
